verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents managed databases on a shared Appwrite-managed pool or dedicated compute, with serverless or dedicated tiers per database. These include TablesDB (typed columns, rows, relationships, indexes) exposed through managed APIs with permissions and realtime, plus a managed PostgreSQL option. Access is through 'one of our many SDKs' or REST/GraphQL, and the CLI can generate a type-safe SDK from the schema. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of read/write via separate client vs server SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of current database read/write.
